nameEn: Manufacture of builders' carpentry and joinery
description: This class includes the manufacture of builders' carpentry and joinery products of wood.
includes: manufacture of wooden doors, windows, shutters, frames
manufacture of wooden stairways, railings, banisters
manufacture of prefabricated wooden buildings and components: panels, sections
manufacture of assembled parquet floor panels
manufacture of portable wooden buildings: huts, sheds
excludes: manufacture of veneer sheets and wood-based panels, see 1621
construction of prefabricated wooden buildings, see 4100
